title: About iHogu Studio
subtitle: A warm handmade felt studio creating soft pieces with patience and quiet imagination.

sections.title: About the Studio
sections.body: iHogu is a one-person felt art studio. Every piece is made slowly, by hand, with care.

materials.name: Wool Felt
materials.description: Soft, warm, and expressive for tiny handmade scenes.
materials.note: Used for figures, houses, flowers, and textured ground.

materials.name: Cotton
materials.description: Light supporting details for small decorations and labels.
materials.note: Used where a softer fabric touch is needed.

sections.title: Every Piece Has a Story
sections.body: Every finished object carries a unique number, a date, and a quiet record of how it was made.
